THE BLOCK IS THE KHANNA 2025 FINDING — 'Supported by a 2025 systematic review of topical glutathione', a systematic review of published clinical trials of topical glutathione formulations, concluding measurable benefits for the appearance of skin tone and favourable safety and tolerability.

⚠️ THE CANDIDATE WAS BRIEFED AT f1's MAGNITUDE, NOT f3's, AND THAT IS WORTH KNOWING. Slot 'c' belongs to the f1 family (Watanabe 2014, 2% GSSG, ten weeks, melanin index p < 0.001), whose brief licenses a CLEARLY VISIBLE evening. f3's own slots were capped deliberately at 'real but modest', because a pooled review conclusion carries no percentage and an emphatic before/after overstates it — the same reasoning that capped acetyl's f3. This frame sits at the stronger end. Malcolm chose it with the f3 alternates (e/f/g/h) on screen beside it, so it is a decision, not an oversight, and it is recorded here rather than re-litigated. The honesty rules themselves all hold on this frame — see the verification below.

VERIFIED AT 100% ON THIS FRAME BEFORE PUBLISHING, not from the contact sheet:
  - THE SPLIT is at 49.95% of width — the strongest vertical edge sits one pixel off dead centre, so the master is an even diptych and would carry the research-before-after section's labels correctly if that section is ever adopted here.
  - NO MARK HAS DISAPPEARED. The moles beside the nose and along the jaw, and the small scattered sun spots, are all present in the right panel in the same places. This is the rule three engines broke in round 1 and the whole reason round 2 exists.
  - SHE IS NOT A PALER PERSON. The skin of her jaw and neck reads the same olive in both panels; what has evened is the soft-edged brown patch over the cheekbone, which is fainter but still findable in the same place.
  - TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS, as Malcolm asked: different room (pale greige wall with a lampshade at the edge / muted sage-grey with a curtain fall), different daylight direction, different garment, different hair fall, and a visibly different head angle and eye gaze between the halves.
  - NO BAKED-IN TEXT of any kind, no hand, no phone, no mirror and no reflection in either panel.

NO LABELS ON THIS BLOCK, AND THAT IS A REAL GAP. media-with-text has no caption, overlay, label or badge setting — every setting on both of its block types was checked on 2026-08-27. The sibling research pages (/pages/acetyl-hexapeptide-8-research, /pages/pdrn-research) carry their diptychs in the custom `research-before-after` section, which renders Before / After / a result line as DOM TEXT over the image, translatable through Translate & Adapt. Dropping a diptych into media-with-text means a visitor sees two photographs of the same woman with nothing telling them which is which. Raised with Malcolm; not actioned here, because he asked for an image replacement and moving the block between sections is a structural change to his page.

SQUARE, 1:1, NON-NEGOTIABLE — media-with-text has no aspect-ratio on the media div and the row height is set by the master's own aspect, so a non-square file would make this block taller than f1 and f2. Note the row is also sized by the copy: a long text column cover-crops a square master a little at the edges. That is a layout fact of the section, not a fault in the file, and it is measured on the live page after publishing rather than assumed.

OPTIMISED, NOT COMPRESSED. The uploader caps the long edge at 3000 (the widest the theme's srcset ever requests), strips EXIF and ICC, and encodes once at quality 95, 4:4:4. The source handed to it is the ORIGINAL PNG, not an intermediate JPEG, so the picture is JPEG-encoded exactly once. Re-encoding harder was measured on this store on 2026-08-24 and made pages marginally SLOWER: Shopify's CDN transcodes every image to WebP and resizes per srcset, so the source JPEG is never what a visitor downloads.

NEW FILENAME, NEVER A RE-UPLOAD: Shopify Files suffixes a name collision and keeps serving the original. Checked against 250 live files that this stem is not a prefix of any of them and that none of them is a prefix of it, because the uploader binds by prefix while polling and this repo has twice bound two slots to the same image. ALT TEXT describes the picture as an illustration and claims no result.
